title: Nyaamdu Mawɗo mo sikkaano
intro: E nder nokkuuji ceniiɗi galle Alla, maccuɗo Alla mawɗo gooto heɓi sirlu luggiɗiiɗo, mo ƴaañii kala ko ina sikkaa. Oo neɗɗo dewondirɗo, ɓooyɗo duuɓi jibinannde tagoore, seedtii huunde haawniinde, feeñninnde yurmeende Alla nde alaa keerol. Puzzle ina woni e udditde oo sahaa yejjitaaɗo e nguurndam annabaaɓe.
clues: Leñol am ina anndiranoo Israayiil, iwdi mawndi mawndi ɓooyndi.
Miɗo waɗa jammaaji am e nder duwaawu, miɗo sujjana yeeso Joomiraawo am e nder suudu dewal.
Mi rokkaama ɓiɗɗo gorko e nder mawngu am, dokkal ngal mi meeɗaa woppude teddinde Alla.
Ñaawoore am ndee ko yiytude nguura feeñnde e ruuhu cukalel gonngel e les njiimaandi am.
Miin ko mi annabi biyeteeɗo Zakariyya, halfinaa mi toppitaade Maryam e nder Bayt al Maqdis.
Jaabawol ngol woni ko e aaye mo Alla jaɓi Maryam, rokki ɗum nguura.

identity.label: Hol ko ngonmi?
options: Annabi toppitiiɗo Mariyam e nder suudu dewal
Annabi kaaldiiɗo e Alla to bannge laaɓal
identity.answer: Annabi toppitiiɗo Mariyam e nder suudu dewal

trial.label: Ñaawoore/Kewu
options: Yiytude nguura sirlu ina rokka ward sukaaɓe
Waaju e leñol ngol salii ardaade Alla
Woɗeede e nder ŋoral leñol mum
trial.answer: Yiytude nguura sirlu ina rokka ward sukaaɓe

location.label: Elemen keyɗo
options: Laana mahaaɗo e leɗɗe e ƴiye

outcome.label: Keeɓal
options: Yimɓe ɓee ngoongɗini, ndewi e nulaaɗo
Jaɓde Alla e yurmeende wonande ɓeen dariiɓe dewal
Ɓiɗɗo gorko jibinaama e mawngu no fodoore nii
outcome.answer: Jaɓɓugol Alla e yurmeende wonande ɓeen dariiɓe dewal

arabic: فَتَقَبَّلَهَا رَبُّهَا بِقَبُولٍ حَسَنٍۢ وَأَنۢبَتَهَا نَبَاتًا حَسَنًۭا وَكَفَّلَهَا زَكَرِيَّا ۖ كُلَّمَا دَخَلَ عَلَيْهَا زَكَرِيَّا ٱلْمِحْرَابَ وَجَدَ عِندَهَا رِزْقًۭا ۖ قَالَ يَـٰمَرْيَمُ أَنَّىٰ لَكِ هَـٰذَا ۖ قَالَتْ هُوَ مِنْ عِندِ ٱللَّهِ ۖ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَرْزُقُ مَن يَشَآءُ بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍ
verse: So her Lord accepted her with good acceptance and caused her to grow in a good manner and put her in the care of Zechariah. Every time Zechariah entered upon her in the prayer chamber, he found with her provision. He said, "O Mary, from where is this [coming] to you?" She said, "It is from Allāh. Indeed, Allāh provides for whom He wills without account." (3:37)
